title: Negative curvature forces an antivortex, and finding it is PPADS-complete
subject: The complexity of the defect the knot's count forces on a negatively curved knot space
conclusion: On the genus-2 double of a holed lattice torus with Kasteleyn signs, the count forces some face to over-agree, and finding such a face is PPADS^dt-complete while finding a violated line or an over-agreeing face is PPAD^dt-complete. A frame developed across the six degree-8 faces carries one antivortex and leaves every line satisfied, and the mirrored Sperner map puts over-agreeing faces exactly in clockwise fully labelled triangles.
